office: the General Directorate of Civil Registration (Ministry of Interior), at civil registry offices

routes.label: in person at a civil registry office in Sudan

note: Landinfo's report on Sudanese civil registration and documents (3 March 2023): the card is issued only in Sudan, to citizens over 16 registered with a national identity number (the Civil Registry Act 2011, art. 27, makes it compulsory over 16); it is normally valid five years; issuance was halted in places from 2021 (not modelled). The fee isn't stated, so it's null; so is the time.

sources.title: Landinfo, Report Sudan: Civil Registration, Identity Documents and Passports (3 March 2023), on ecoi.net
sources.said: The ID card is normally valid for five years (DISCS n.d.-c). 3.1 Issuance ID cards are only issued in Sudan, by the General Directorate of Civil Registration. It is issued to Sudanese citizens over the age of 16 who are registered in the civil registry with a national identity number.
